Two separate road accidents result in multiple fatalities

Two separate road accidents have resulted in multiple fatalities across India. In Indore, a speeding car collided with an "Activa" scooter, killing two friends who were out for a ride. In Rajasthan, a speeding car hit people standing on the roadside, causing two immediate deaths. Separately, in Lakhimpur, a car crashed into a transformer, killing three people and leaving three others in serious condition.
